method.snapshot: Synthetic realistic photo metadata, 10k and 50k; each warm result is the minimum of five refreshes. Three independent process runs per revision; summaries are medians of those minima. Cold refresh and upsert have one sample per process. Catalog on the same persistent filesystem as the checkout; warm page cache. Includes actor publication, excludes UI and end-to-end frame presentation.
method.ingest: 128 distinct generated 200000-byte files plus one backup on the same persistent filesystem. Fresh fixture per process, source creation before timing. Includes copy, BLAKE3 verification, fsync, catalog commit, and manifest finalization. Three independent process runs per revision. Excludes camera media, real RAW decoding, and separate backup devices.
method.grid: 36 visible cells over a 5k plan, 2000 iterations per path. Former clone/format work is emulated alongside the shared-cell model in the final binary. Data preparation only, excludes GPUI layout, GPU upload, and presentation.
method.host: Ordinary desktop processes remained running. No compiler or other Shadowroom test process ran during measurements. Host was not CPU-isolated.
method.memory: Peak RSS is for the entire benchmark process and includes fixture vectors and grouping workers. It is not steady-state application RSS.
